# SD18-PRELOOP consumer-side composition deterministic input fixture.
#
# Human Fighter level 5 with mid-ability scores, Human bonus feat selected
# (Dodge), and the deterministic Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield
# posture. Used by tests/sd18_preloop_consumer_compose.rs to verify that
# the consumer-side composer accepts a Human Fighter level 5 input and
# produces a ComposedCharacterInput that reaches pilot_compute.rs without
# panic. The corpus-side of the composition is constructed in the test
# itself (a TestCorpus in /tmp) so this fixture is chosen-state only;
# it deliberately mirrors the SD-13 level-5 Human Fighter acceptance
# surface because that surface is what the rules engine already supports.
#
# Authoritative references:
# - programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/decisions.md (pre-loop vs. loop lane split)
# - programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/technical-design.md (Pre-loop section 1.1)
# - programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
